asset_dedup.title: Image Asset Deduplication
asset_dedup.desc: Review visually similar images only across different sources and Works
asset_dedup.policy: Reconciliation is strictly cross-source. Pages from the same Work and images from the same source never participate, even when SHA-256 is identical. After the visual hard gate passes, canonical creator identity and posting dates within 30 days may add confidence. Lower-quality variants are quarantined for 30 days; Works, WorkSources, and source ordering never merge.

asset_dedup.confirm_message: Both source records and Works remain intact. The selected image becomes the display representative; lower-quality variants with different bytes are quarantined for 30 days before cleanup.

gitllery_settings.governance_desc: The controller observes host signals to assess safety, but every scheduling, throttling, and pause action is limited to auto-gallery. Hard limits are a safety net; the main savings come from incremental discovery, micro-batches, idempotent outboxes, resource profiles, and AIMD.
gitllery_settings.swap_desc: Swap writes temporarily unused memory pages to disk. It cushions memory shortages but sustained paging adds latency and I/O contention. The controller combines paging rate, available-memory trend, and SwapFree; auto-gallery containers themselves cannot use Swap.
gitllery_settings.enforce_project: Constrain auto-gallery tasks and containers only
gitllery_settings.no_other_projects: Never stop or modify other Docker projects
gitllery_settings.no_host_changes: Never modify host resource configuration or system services
gitllery_settings.algorithm_aimd: Three-state AIMD halves budgets under pressure and restores them gradually while preserving low-rate progress outside hard risk
gitllery_settings.algorithm_incremental: Downloads discover only the current delta; imports claim 25-work micro-batches and checkpoint at boundaries
gitllery_settings.algorithm_outbox: CAS leases and idempotent outboxes recover after crashes and reject stale-worker writes
gitllery_settings.algorithm_workers: Single-pass media, streamed search projection, fair keyset scheduling, and low-frequency event wakeups reduce actual work

dedup.cross_source.desc: SHA-256 match across sources = reuse asset record.
dedup.auto_merge.desc: Automatically merge visually similar works. DANGEROUS — may irreversibly modify your library.
dedup.phash.desc: Perceptual-hash Hamming hard gate (0-4). Lower is stricter; default 4.
dedup.warning: Changes take effect immediately. Enable dedup only after reviewing risk docs.
dedup.warning_auto: Auto-merge is enabled — this may irreversibly modify your library!
dedup.auto_group.desc: Only images from different sources and Works that pass the visual hard gate and automatic threshold are grouped. Each visual group contains at most one asset per source.
dedup.ssim.desc: Minimum structural similarity after image normalization. Default: 0.98.
dedup.auto_score.desc: Threshold after visual evidence and metadata bonuses.
dedup.review_score.desc: Candidates below this score are excluded from manual review.
dedup.quarantine.desc: Retention before permanently removing a lower-quality, different-byte visual variant.
dedup.safety_note: Pages from the same Work and images from the same source are always excluded, even for identical SHA-256. Metadata adds confidence only after visual validation: same creator +6; posting delta ≤1 day +4, ≤7 days +2, ≤30 days +1. Different-byte files enter quarantine.
proxy.title: Network Proxy
proxy.desc: Configure HTTP/HTTPS proxy for external API access and gallery-dl downloads.
proxy.enable.desc: Route external API calls and gallery-dl traffic through a proxy server.
proxy.http.desc: Used for HTTP requests (Danbooru API, etc.). Leave empty to not use HTTP proxy.
proxy.https.desc: Used for HTTPS connections. Usually same as HTTP proxy.
proxy.no.desc: Comma-separated hosts to bypass proxy. Default: localhost,127.0.0.1,::1
proxy.ssl_verify.desc: Verify SSL certificates. Disable if using a proxy that intercepts HTTPS (Clash/V2Ray).
proxy.ssl_off_warn: SSL verification is disabled. Needed for Clash/V2Ray MITM proxies but reduces security. gallery-dl will be invoked with --no-ssl-verify.
proxy.scope.1: gallery-dl subprocess (downloads from Pixiv, Twitter, Iwara)
proxy.scope.2: Danbooru API reference queries (artist search, URL import)
proxy.scope.3: Other external HTTP calls made by the backend
proxy.known_config: Known configuration: If your proxy performs HTTPS interception (MITM), disable SSL Verification below. Proxy URL format: http://<proxy-host>:<port> (e.g. http://192.0.2.10:7890).
proxy.connectivity_test.desc: Tests direct and proxy connectivity to Pixiv, Danbooru, X, Iwara, and Google.
proxy.troubleshoot: Check: Is the proxy port open? Is the proxy container running? Is the URL correct (http://host:port)?
auth.title: Auth & Cookie Status
auth.desc: Monitor authentication health for all subscription sources.
auth.no_sources_desc: Create a subscription with sources to monitor auth health.
auth.how: Auth status records only real download attempts; never-checked sources remain unknown. Credential availability is tracked separately. HTTP 401/403, expired cookies or tokens, and login-required failures pause the source until a successful download restores it.
subdefaults.title: Subscription Defaults
subdefaults.desc: Default sync settings and scheduler behavior.
subdefaults.mode.desc: Interval: sync every N hours. Fixed Time: sync at specific times of day.
subdefaults.interval.desc: Sync each subscription when this many hours have passed since last sync.
subdefaults.fixed_times.desc: Comma-separated HH:MM times. Sync runs at these moments each day.
subdefaults.fixed_times.hint: Example: "00:00, 06:00, 12:00, 18:00" for every 6 hours at fixed moments.
subdefaults.scheduler_enabled.desc: When disabled, background scans create no sync jobs. Manual Sync now still works.
subdefaults.scan_interval.desc: How often the scheduler wakes up to check for due subscriptions (minutes). Min 5.
subdefaults.sync_enabled.desc: New subscriptions start with auto-sync enabled.
subdefaults.schedule_mode.desc: Interval: sync every N hours. Scheduled: sync at specific times each day.
subdefaults.frequency.desc: Run daily, on selected weekdays, or on selected month dates, with multiple times in one rule.
subdefaults.month_days.desc: Select one or more dates. Dates absent from a shorter month, such as the 31st, are combined into one run on that month's last day.
subdefaults.scheduled_times.desc: Comma-separated HH:MM times. Sync runs at these moments each day.
subdefaults.scheduled_times.example: Example: "03:00, 15:00" — sync at 3 AM and 3 PM each day.
subdefaults.timezone.desc: Timezone used for scheduled sync. Use Asia/Shanghai for China.
subdefaults.sync_interval.desc: Number of hours between automatic syncs (1–168).
scheduler.explain_desc: Explain queue state and source-level scheduler decisions.
scheduler.decision_desc: Read-only source/repo decisions. This page never enqueues jobs by itself.
scheduler.no_sources_desc: Create subscriptions and source URLs to see scheduler decisions.
scheduler.reason.already_attempted_in_sl: Already attempted in this calendar slot
scheduler.reason.already_synced_in_slot: Already synced in this calendar slot
scheduler.paused_desc: No automatic sync jobs will be created. {count} due sources are globally suppressed, while their schedules and policies remain unchanged. Manual sync is still available.
scheduler.search_placeholder: Search creator, source, URL, or source ID...
scheduler.sync_all_result: Checked {total} enabled sources: {enqueued} queued, {skipped} skipped, {errors} failed
scheduler.batch_terminal: Downloads and main imports reached a terminal outcome
scheduler.batch_progress.cancelling: Cleaning up child work for the cancelled batch
scheduler.batch_progress.cancelled: Batch cancelled and child cleanup complete
scheduler.batch_progress.noop: Batch finished without synchronizing a source
scheduler.batch_waiting_snapshot: Waiting for the first durable progress snapshot
scheduler.batch_completion_boundary: Completion covers downloads and main imports. Follow media, search, and Git projections in System status.
scheduler.batch_background_link: View media, search, and Git projection status
scheduler.batch_cleanup_pending: Publication stopped; child cleanup is still running
scheduler.batch_task_error: Batch status could not be refreshed.
scheduler.batch_items_error: Batch outcome details could not be loaded.
scheduler.batch_tracking_irrecoverable: This saved batch can no longer be accessed.
scheduler.batch_tracking_network: The network is unavailable. The saved batch reference was retained for a safe retry.
scheduler.batch_tracking_http: The server rejected the tracking request (HTTP {status}). The saved batch reference was retained.
scheduler.batch_tracking_unknown: The tracking request failed. The saved batch reference was retained.
dldefaults.title: Download Job Defaults
dldefaults.desc: Configure timeout, retry, and backoff for gallery-dl download jobs.
dldefaults.auto_resolve_conflicts.desc: When an upstream file for the same source work changes, adopt the latest source version and append new pages automatically. Enabled by default.
dldefaults.auto_resolve_conflicts.safety: Runs only when source, repository, work, creator, page, and source-asset identities all agree. Missing upstream pages never delete local content; replaced files are kept for 30 days and can be rolled back.
dldefaults.timeout.desc: Maximum time for a single download job (seconds). Default 600.
dldefaults.retries.desc: Number of retry attempts before marking as failed. Default 3.
dldefaults.backoff.desc: Base delay in seconds for exponential backoff: base × 2^(retry-1). Default 60.
dldefaults.schedule.desc: Attempt 1 → fail → wait {base}s → Attempt 2 → fail → wait {double}s → Attempt 3 → fail → marked as failed. Max {max} retries.
dldefaults.max_posts.desc: Maximum posts per gallery-dl run (--range 1-N). Increase for prolific creators, decrease for low-frequency ones. Default 200.
dldefaults.skip_ai.desc: When enabled, skips AI-generated works. Pixiv: uses ai-type=1 to download non-AI only. Danbooru: excludes ai_generated tag from search.
dldefaults.stall_timeout.desc: Seconds without progress output before killing gallery-dl and triggering a retry. Must be less than the overall timeout.
dldefaults.gallerydl_retries.desc: Per-HTTP-request retry count (--retries flag). Handles transient network hiccups.
dldefaults.gallerydl_abort.desc: Exit early after N consecutive already-archived items (--abort flag). Reduces re-scan overhead.
dldefaults.concurrency.desc: How many download jobs run at once (1-5). Restart the download worker to apply a change.
dldefaults.concurrency.restart_hint: Changing parallel downloads takes effect after restarting the download worker.
dldefaults.concurrency.effective: Saved setting {configured}, current worker effective concurrency {effective}, NAS cap {cap}.
dldefaults.concurrency.restart_required: Desired effective concurrency is {desired}; restart the download worker to apply it.
dldefaults.concurrency.applied: The download worker is using desired effective concurrency {desired}.

logs.no_entries_desc: Try changing the level, source, or entry limit.
datamgmt.title: Data Management
datamgmt.desc: Clear downloads, works, creators, subscriptions. Reset settings to defaults.
datamgmt.warning: Operations below are irreversible. Confirm before proceeding.
datamgmt.clear_downloads.desc: Delete all files under /downloads/. Does not affect database.
datamgmt.clear_library.desc: Delete only metadata.json and thumbnail files under /library/. Does NOT touch original media files in downloads, does NOT modify database records.
datamgmt.rebuild_library.desc: Regenerate metadata.json and thumbnails under /library/ from database records. Use after clearing the library index. Does not overwrite existing files.
datamgmt.clear_works.desc: Delete all works, assets, tags, import/download jobs from database.
datamgmt.clear_creators.desc: Delete all creators and associated links from database.
datamgmt.clear_subs.desc: Delete all subscriptions and source configurations from database.
datamgmt.clear_all.desc: Wipe all database records AND all download/library files. Complete reset.
datamgmt.clear_all_success: All data, files, and Redis failed jobs were cleared
datamgmt.clear_jobs.desc: Delete all download and import job records, and flush the Redis failed job queue. Downloaded files are not affected.
datamgmt.clear_jobs_success: All download and import jobs were cleared
datamgmt.reset_settings.desc: Restore dedup, proxy, scheduler, and all other settings to defaults.
backup.title: Backup & Restore
backup.desc: Selectively back up system data (database, configs, download archives, metadata) or restore from a backup file.
backup.no_backups_desc: Select the components to back up, then click Create.
backup.restore_desc: Upload and validate a backup in chunks. The app only creates an offline handoff; the host script owns the locked, rollback-safe restore.
backup.restore_confirm: Stage and validate this backup? This step does not modify the live database, configuration, or services.
backup.restore_handoff_desc: Validation is complete. Run the command below on the host; execution uses an exclusive lock, external receipt, and executable rollback point.
backup.restore_receipt_pending: Waiting for the host script receipt…
backup.restore_receipt_success: Restore succeeded and all services restarted in phases.
backup.item_db_desc: Creators, subscriptions, works, tags, settings, job history
backup.item_library_desc: metadata.json files, can rebuild work index
datamgmt.confirm_msg: Are you sure you want to {action}? This cannot be undone.
datamgmt.storage_unlinked_desc: These disk directories are not matched to a creator or subscription repository yet.
datamgmt.data_center_error: Data Center overview could not be loaded
datamgmt.integrity_clean_desc: All checks passed. Data integrity is good.
datamgmt.cleanup_json_desc: Remove gallery-dl intermediate JSON files from the original media store (safe after import)
datamgmt.cleanup_json_partial: Cleanup partially failed: {removed} removed, {skipped} skipped, {failed} failed
datamgmt.cleanup_reindex_desc: Regenerate library metadata.json files and thumbnails, and repair related search projections. Meilisearch is not cleared.
datamgmt.cleanup_reindex_confirm_msg: This starts a background job that regenerates library metadata and thumbnails and repairs related search projections. Original files are not deleted.
datamgmt.cleanup_reindex_accepted: Library rebuild submitted. Track its progress in Jobs.
datamgmt.disk_import_desc: Scan the download directory and import on-disk-but-unindexed files into the database (idempotent; no re-download/delete)
datamgmt.disk_import_reset_ledger: Reset ledger (recover creators/works deleted from the DB)
datamgmt.reenrich_desc: Re-query Danbooru for creators flagged as pending enrichment and wire up artist mappings and cross-platform links (idempotent)
datamgmt.danger_warning: These operations are irreversible. Ensure you have a backup first.
datamgmt.danger_clear_works_desc: Delete all works, assets, tags, and related job records
datamgmt.danger_clear_creators_desc: Delete all creators, source accounts, and associations
datamgmt.danger_clear_subs_desc: Delete all subscriptions and source configurations
datamgmt.danger_clear_tags_desc: Delete all tags and work associations
datamgmt.danger_clear_all_desc: Wipe all database records and download/library files
datamgmt.danger_reset_settings_desc: Restore all system settings to defaults

deletion.soft_message: This only disables or archives the target. Configuration and files are not permanently removed and can be restored later.

deletion.delete_files: Also permanently delete exclusive work files
deletion.delete_files_desc: Removes originals, thumbnails, and quarantined files while retaining work and media audit records.
